title: Materialize current sensor relationship compression readout
objective: Implement the smallest deterministic research-only readout that summarizes existing sensor-family relationship evidence using the canonical relationship vocabulary, distinguishes historical from prospective evidence and exposes presentation roles for double-count prevention without changing weights or market semantics.
primary_target: scripts/experiments/directly related sensor relationship compression helper
allowed_change_scope: scripts/experiments/directly related read-only sensor relationship/compression helper

evidence.summary: Canonical standard requires explicit relationship classes and simplification rather than aligned-signal counting.
Historical relationship audit exists but is not a current prospective operational compression surface.
Program finding freezes a read-only current relationship/compression requirement with no authority change.

reproduction: On fresh main, confirm the canonical relationship standard and historical audit artifacts exist, then confirm no current compact machine-readable readout reconciles registered sensor families/tests into canonical relationship states with sample/eligibility and historical-vs-prospective evidence status for downstream double-count prevention.

positive: Known related sensor/test families are represented using only canonical relationship classes with exact source/test IDs and evidence class/sample status.
Presentation roles PRIMARY/VALIDATION/AUDIT_ONLY/DATA_BLOCKED/UNRESOLVED are clearly non-weighting metadata and preserve unresolved states.
negative: Low Pearson/Spearman correlation alone cannot produce UNIQUE.
No sensor is removed, promoted, reweighted or counted as independent confirmation by this readout.
